name: daoris-workspace
description: Workspace root. The publishable CLI is src/Daoris.Cli; nothing here is published.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck -w daoris && npm test -w daoris && node src/Daoris.Cli/bin/daoris.mjs check && node tools/doc-budgets.mjs && node tools/doc-shapes.mjs && node tools/doc-duplicates.mjs && node tools/doc-system.mjs && node tools/partials.mjs && node --test tools/orient-index.test.mjs tools/fsx.test.mjs tools/rehearsal-kit.test.mjs tools/doc-system.test.mjs tools/subagent-usage.test.mjs tools/shell-edit-guard.test.mjs tools/partials.test.mjs tools/move-files.test.mjs tools/fabric-probe.test.mjs && node tools/release-prep.mjs --check && node tools/as-merged.mjs dotnet run --project src/Daoris.Devkit/Daoris.Devkit.Cli -- verify --universal-only --allow-builtins-only
scripts.check:web-rules: npm --prefix src/Daoris.Web run test -- src/design/tokens.test.ts src/test/structure.test.ts
scripts.test:web: npm run test:web:unit && npm run test:web:e2e
scripts.test:web:e2e: npm --prefix src/Daoris.Web run build && dotnet build src/Daoris.Service/Daoris.Service.Http && npm --prefix src/Daoris.Web run e2e
